subject: angol
title: Live culture or streaming at home
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval az élő kulturális élményekről és a streamingszolgáltatások hatásáról.

scenes.description: In an elegant old theatre with red velvet seats and golden balconies, the audience is giving a standing ovation at the end of a play. The actors are bowing on the stage, holding hands. In the front row, a teenage girl is clapping enthusiastically next to her grandmother, who is wiping a tear from her eye. Everyone is dressed up for the evening.

A teenage boy is lying in bed late at night, watching a series on his phone, with the light of the screen on his face. A message on the screen says 'Next episode starts in 5 seconds'. There is a bag of crisps beside him, and his school bag is lying on the floor, still unopened. The clock on the bedside table shows 1:30 a.m.

prompts: Compare the two ways of enjoying a story and the experiences of the people.
Is live entertainment still important in the age of streaming? Why?
How do streaming services influence our habits, for example our sleep and attention?
followUpQuestions: Why do you think fewer young people go to the theatre than in the past?
Have you ever binge-watched a series? How did you feel afterwards?
Should theatre and concert tickets be cheaper for students? Who should pay for that?
Can a film or a series be as valuable as a book or a play? Why?

usefulPhrases.hu: A második kép azt sugallja, hogy ...

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text:
Both pictures show people enjoying a story, but in very different ways. The first one is set in an elegant old theatre with red velvet seats, at the end of a play. The audience is giving a standing ovation, and in the front row a teenage girl is clapping enthusiastically next to her grandmother, who's wiping away a tear. In the second picture, a teenage boy is lying in bed at half past one in the morning, watching a series on his phone. The next episode is about to start automatically, and his school bag is still unopened on the floor.
The main difference is that the theatre is a shared experience which the girl and her grandmother will remember for a long time, while the boy is alone and probably won't even remember what he watched. I think live entertainment is still important, because nothing can replace the atmosphere of a real performance. Streaming services, on the other hand, are designed to keep us watching, and autoplay is a real trap – I've stayed up far too late because of it more than once.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Should theatre and concert tickets be cheaper for students? Who should pay for that?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Definitely, because if young people don't get used to going to the theatre now, they never will. The state and local councils could subsidise student tickets, and some theatres already offer cheap last-minute seats for students.

notes: Összefüggő témakifejtés: a vizsgázó mindkét jelenetet részletesen leírja, az összehasonlítást a közös és a magányos élmény ellentétére építi, érvel az élő előadások mellett, saját példával mutatja be a streaming alvásra gyakorolt hatását, a visszakérdezésre pedig megoldást javasol.
Szókincs: gazdag, témához illő szókincs (standing ovation, wiping away a tear, autoplay, subsidise, a shared experience) és jól tagolt érvelés (The main difference is that …, on the other hand).

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos és hibátlan szerkezetek – 'is about to start', szenvedő szerkezet (are designed to), Present Perfect (I've stayed up far too late … more than once) és első feltételes mondat (if young people don't …, they never will).
Érdemes megtanulni: „a shared experience”, „nothing can replace the atmosphere of a real performance”, „a real trap”, „get used to going to the theatre”.
